purpose: Predeclare three independent external-data tests of the already frozen finite-memory AeST model before reading any ACT/SPT/lensing memory-fit result.

tests.dataset: ACT DR6 foreground-marginalized CMB-only TT/TE/EE likelihood
tests.inference: free eta versus eta=0, with six standard cosmological parameters and ACT calibration/polarization nuisance parameters profiled
tests.reason: Independent primary-CMB experiment, restricted to the already certified ell<=2500 theory range.

tests.inference: free eta versus eta=0 with the same six cosmological parameters and the likelihood's required nuisance model

tests.dataset: ACT DR6 CMB lensing auto-spectrum likelihood
tests.inference: free eta versus eta=0 using the public ACT DR6 lensing likelihood in lens-only mode before any combined primary-CMB+lensing fit
tests.reason: Independent gravitational observable sensitive to integrated Weyl-potential evolution rather than only primary TT/TE/EE.

decision_rule: All three tests will be reported irrespective of sign or significance. No result-dependent selection of experiments, multipole cuts, KB, tauH0, p, lambda, CLASS commit, or memory forcing construction is allowed.
anti_tuning: The three-test campaign is frozen before inspecting any of these external memory-fit results. Technical changes required to make a public likelihood run must be documented before re-reading the corresponding eta result and must not be chosen to increase the eta preference.
